- Overall performance: The company's revenue after eliminations is $12.31 billion with a gross margin of 45.3% and an EBITDA margin of 25.8%.
- The company that contributes most to the revenue is Wipro Consumer Care International with $6.23 billion, and the one that needs attention is Wipro Consumer Care India due to its lower EBITDA margin of 17.2% compared to Wipro Consumer Care International's 34.3%.
- Margins: The company has a gross margin of 45.3% and an EBITDA margin of 25.8%, with Wipro Consumer Care International having a gross margin of 43.9% and Wipro Consumer Care India having a gross margin of 46.8%.
- Working capital: As of 2025-12-01, the working capital is managed with 121 days of DSO and 405 days of DPO, indicating a need for improvement in accounts receivable collection.
- Top 3 revenue drivers: The top drivers are everything excluding profit centre US10_PECS with a revenue change of $0.49 billion (84.4% of total change), SAP product sales (GL 41000000) excluding entity 310 Wipro Consumer Care India - South (310), profit centre US10_PECS with a revenue change of $0.44 billion (75.7% of total change), and SAP product sales (GL 41000000) excluding entity 310 Wipro Consumer Care India - South (310), entity USC1 Wipro Consumer Care International - US Corporate (USC1), profit centre US10_PECS, profit centre US10_PEML, profit centre US10_PEMS, profit centre US10_PLX with a revenue change of $0.22 billion (37.1% of total change).
